title: Commercial Real Estate Transactions and Regeneration Risk
publisher: New York City Department of Finance via NYC Open Data
citation: New York City Department of Finance, NYC Citywide Annualized Calendar Sales Update
version: filtered 2021-2025 commercial-unit snapshot from dataset w2pb-icbu
